class.name: CrimsonEOSProvider
class.brief_description: Native Epic Online Services provider for a developer-signed-in listen host or guest.
class.description: Configure the private deployment and await [method login_developer] before attaching the game. The provider uses EOS Lobbies to publish and resolve an active world, then verifies EOS Connect identity during P2P admission. The sign-in owner must stay in the scene tree for the lifetime of the game. Configure a separate provider for each active game.

method.name: configure
method.description: Returns a provider for the supplied EOS product, sandbox, deployment, and client policy. Supply the client secret at runtime. The resource does not serialize the secret. Set [param force_relay] to use only the Epic relay for a live transport test.

method.name: get_product_user_id
method.description: Returns the local EOS Product User ID after sign-in, or an empty string while unavailable.

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Returns whether EOS Connect has authenticated the provider's local identity.

method.name: login_developer
method.description: Signs in through Epic's Developer Authentication Tool and connects the account to the private deployment. Pass a persistent [param owner] already in the scene tree, the tool's host and port, and a credential name configured in the tool. Await success before attaching the game. This method is for development sessions.
